description:
Use this when the user wants to see their posting queue: "when does my queue post", "what are my queue
        slots", "which days and times do I post". Returns the weekly times the user set in RipClip for its posting
        queue, in their own local time. Takes no parameters.
        Not for: when the user's audience is online (best_time_to_post), posts already planned (get_post_stats) or
        changing the times (set_queue_times). Free and read only.
name: get_queue_times
title: Get queue times
